messages:
Sophie Cogswell: Uploading the DPA artifacts Acadia asked for into /shared/acadia/dpa — they specifically want a quick snapshot of what we shared (SOC2 scope doc, dataflow, KMS attestations). cc @Priya @Marisol
Marisol Patel: Thanks Sophie. Can you list the exact filenames? I want to confirm nothing sensitive leaks before we hand off.
Alex Nguyen: Files are in S3: `s3://redwood-cs/acadia/dpa/` — current objects: `soc2_scope_v2.pdf`, `acadia_dataflow_redacted.png`, `kms_keylist.csv`, `dpa_signed_2024-09-10.pdf`.
Priya Shah: Legal needs to know if the dataflow contains customer-specific PII. If so we should re-redact. Also confirm the KMS artifact is an exported key list, not key material.
Sophie Cogswell: The dataflow is already redacted but I'll double-check fields. KMS file is a list of key IDs + regions only.
Marisol Patel: Also, the customer asked for retention window evidence (embeddings retention). Do we have the retention policy doc in the bundle?
Alex Nguyen: There is `retention_policy_embeddings_v1.docx` in the same bucket. I'll attach a presigned link here once I generate it.
ops-bot: Uploaded file `acadia_dpa_bundle_2024-11-02.zip` to https://files.redwood.internal/abcd1234 (expires in 7 days).
Sophie Cogswell: Copy that. @Priya can you confirm if the current redaction standard is enough for external vendor review? If not, tell us what to remove.
Priya Shah: Quick check: redaction OK as long as flow doesn't show tenant IDs or example customer names. If the PNG contains sample request/response bodies with real emails, redact those. Otherwise fine.
Marisol Patel: Can we provide the customer a short cover note with a checklist so they know what each file is? That tends to reduce back-and-forth. Eg: 1) SOC2 scope, 2) Dataflow (redacted), 3) KMS key list (IDs only), 4) Retention policy.
Sophie Cogswell: Good idea — I'll draft a one-paragraph cover note and attach it to the bundle.
Alex Nguyen: Presigned links ready: `soc2_scope_v2.pdf` -> https://s3.redwood/presign/soc2.pdf (7d), `acadia_dataflow_redacted.png` -> https://s3.redwood/presign/flow.png (7d).
Marisol Patel: Customer asked if we can confirm SOC2 scope includes backend logging services. Can someone confirm quickly?
Alex Nguyen: Confirmed — SOC2 scope doc lists `logging-service-prod` and `infra-ops` under in-scope components (section 2.3).
Sophie Cogswell: Timeline: customer needs this by EOD tomorrow. I'll assemble cover note + bundle now. @Priya, final legal thumbs up by 11:30am?
Priya Shah: I'll review and flag anything before 11:30. If I don't respond by then assume approved. :thumbsup:
Marisol Patel: I'll ping the customer after upload with the checklist and link. Also logging the interaction in the onboarding tracker with renewal-risk tag (they flagged data residency during renewal conversation).
Sophie Cogswell: Thanks team — owner: Sophie to assemble + Marisol to send to customer. Target: 2024-11-03 17:00 UTC.
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up with customer in 3 days if no response.
